pipeline.matching: nearest device-LSB sample per offline PSD epoch; each PSD used once per channel
pipeline.averaging: fixed 10-min bins (floor(t/600s)) per (channel,freq); PSD & matched LSB averaged
pipeline.outlier_rule: Iglewicz-Hoaglin robust z |0.6745*(r-med)/MAD|>3.5 on log10(LSB/uV2) per band (MAD>0 guard)

special.ZERO_THREE_RIGHT_8.8Hz: restricted to >=2026-03-01: chronic 0-3R sensing was reassigned off the 8.8 Hz band on 2025-12-05, then bounced across 28/24.4/26.4 Hz before settling. The 8.8 Hz gain falls through a settling transient over Dec-Feb (post-2025-12-05 within-regime trend -0.078 log10/month, p=0.039) and only reaches stationarity from ~2026-02-15 (p=0.72 -> 0.91 at 03-01). The 03-01 cut isolates the stable current-config regime (n=42, mean 1.69 log10(LSB/uV2), flat trend p=0.91); using the 2025-12-05 config-change date instead would inject the higher-gain declining transient and bias the deployable 8.8 Hz threshold.

fit_basis.estimator: per-channel common slope (OLS log-log, per-frequency intercept); intercept = robust median(logL - b*logP) per band
